_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 91: 2-4 June 2026. Closes tier 1. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He establishes that this was before he won and that it was the word right before the election of 2024, correcting himself from 2020, that the Lord said Trump will be known as a wartime president, and notes that he came out of the box saying he was going to be a man of peace and that he wanted the Nobel Peace Prize.
mentions.quote: the Lord said Trump will be known as a wartime president
mentions.falsify_match: The presidency remembered principally for wars fought during it.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is remembered for something else. The contrast he draws is the strength of it: the subject himself said the opposite at the time, so this was a call against the stated intention rather than with it. The origin recording should be datable.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of praying over this book which is going to be important to him and which the Lord had him write, notes the man made the video two days ago, and says that when he was praying about John Kilpatrick's church, the Church of His Presence, he was seeing about Rosh Hashanah during that time frame of 911 of September.
mentions.quote: praying about John Kilpatrick's church, church of his presence
mentions.falsify_match: Something at that named church around Rosh Hashanah.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing happens. He breaks off before saying what he saw, ending on whether the man is going to do something, so no event is stated. A named church is the only fixed element.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is about the shaking to awaken and the point of no return, that when the man said it last year on September 23rd he said you have entered into the point of no return and this is where they are, that this dispensation of grace is coming to an end, that it is the point of no return for an acceleration, and that they are a couple of months away from September the 11th.
mentions.quote: You've entered into the point of no return
mentions.falsify_match: A marked change dating from 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A point of no return cannot be observed to have been passed or not passed, and the dispensation of grace ending has no test attached. The words are another man's, quoted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the presence of the Lord and that he was touching all the hearts, that he is excited and has anticipation tonight, that what he is seeing again is the scales when the Lord talked about the two years, that the Lord said he will enter into an acceleration of time on September the 11th, and that he is praying for the two-year window.
mentions.quote: you'll enter into a a acceleration of time on on September the 11th
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration of events dating from 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Acceleration of time has no baseline and no unit, so nothing across the two years could count against it.

mentions.claim_text: He says those who believe followed him, that he was a hundred years old and look what God did, that God provided a son when it seemed the most impossible thing to happen and here comes Isaac, asks whether that is not amazing, and tells them to believe and be a believing believer, acknowledging that he brings some very hard things but wanting them encouraged that Jesus has them in the cleft of a rock.
mentions.quote: Whenever it seemed to be the most impossible thing to happen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scriptural encouragement with no stated outcome.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth recording the aside: he says himself that he brings some very hard things, which is an accurate description of the material and an unprompted one.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a major boom as an asteroid or meteor went over Pennsylvania and North Carolina and that it was loud, asks for the clip, and says the Lord showed them several times that as of April the 1st there would be signs from the heavens, that they are about to see major signs from the heavens and that there will be meteors and asteroids and they are coming.
mentions.quote: You're about to see major signs from the heavens
mentions.falsify_match: An unusual rate of fireball events after 1 April.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary rate. A loud daylight fireball over two states is a real reported event, but the American Meteor Society logs thousands of fireball reports a year, so the rate is the question, not the occurrence.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was so loud for something that is coming and that he said this will start on April 1st, repeating it, that the Lord said to watch this time frame going into Rosh Hashanah and into September and that a greater acceleration will come on 911, names the Harbingers, and notes that this just happened on Friday.
mentions.quote: Watch this time frame going into Rashashan, Rashashana into the September
mentions.falsify_match: Escalating celestial events peaking around 11 September.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The window is five months long, the events are of a kind that occur continuously, and greater acceleration has no baseline.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is all in his opinion and he is not a financial adviser, that this is just what he sees in vision and he can miss it, and that he saw this man back in February at a table where they were coming to an agreement, and that he saw three major banks including Chase Bank and Bank of another.
mentions.quote: This is just what I see in vision and and and I can miss it
mentions.falsify_match: An agreement among three named banks.
mentions.falsify_miss: No agreement. The hedge here is the strongest in the corpus and is unprompted: not a financial adviser, only what he sees in vision, and he can miss it. Recorded in full because that qualification is absent from almost everything else on file.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of the antisemitism and says he said Israel pushes the button and it will not be America, that he saw Israel doing it, that they see the fruit of that word coming to pass today, that he said America will stand down and Israel will be the aggressor towards this, that he said they make the mountain glow, and that he saw a surprise attack worse than October coming to Israel in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: Israel pushes the button. It will not be America
mentions.falsify_match: Israel striking first with America standing down.
mentions.falsify_miss: America strikes, or neither does. This is a real either-or with two named actors and it picks one, which is more than most claims here do. The mountain glowing is the part that would distinguish a nuclear reading from a conventional one.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was some kind of yellow on rockets and drones and that they were going to try to spray the people, that it was an attack worse than October of three years ago after correcting himself from two, is helped to settle on three years ago this year, and says they are praying over the harbingers of 911.
mentions.quote: they were going to try to spray the people
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical dispersal attack on Israel by rocket or drone.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. Yellow on the rockets is a specific and checkable detail if such an attack ever occurs, which is more than the claim usually carries.

mentions.claim_text: He says the banking system for the end times and the beast system is an undercurrent in this bill that will come out fast, that digital ID is being pushed around the world and aliens are being talked about as false demonic things about to take place, and that Stephen has a major movie coming out next week, the Alien movie.
mentions.quote: the banking system for the end times for the beast system
mentions.falsify_match: Beast system infrastructure written into the bill.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. An undercurrent in a bill is not a provision of it, so no reading of the text could settle it either way. The film release is a scheduled public event, not something seen.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for a clip to be played and when the day was, is told December, remarks that he is wearing the same shirt and likes the colour, and hears it again: terror in the heartland, terror strikes again in the papers, very tragic taking place.
mentions.falsify_match: A major attack in the American interior reported in those terms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Terror in the heartland is a headline phrase rather than an event, with no place, date or scale, and heartland is not a defined region.

mentions.claim_text: He is prompted with nation in turmoil and repeats it, says he saw this in the headlines in black bold letters, that he was not going to jump right into this but does not want to waste their time, that he has such an urgency in his heart to tell them they must wake up, and establishes the day was May 4th, the first of last month.
mentions.quote: I saw this in the headlines in black bold letters. Nation in turmoil
mentions.falsify_match: That phrase appearing as a front-page headline.
mentions.falsify_miss: None workable. Nation in turmoil is a phrase available to any newspaper in any troubled week, and no publication, date or event is named. The 4 May origin is datable inside this corpus.
